text:
You need a developer who can build your commercial website and guide you through the process even if you’re new to Upwork and technology.

I’m Tobias Reyne, a full-stack developer with 7 years of experience in JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS. I can help turn your idea into a clear, professional website and keep the process simple for you from start to finish.

At Quillstack, I built a streaming tutoring chat widget using React, TypeScript, Server-Sent Events, Node.js, and the OpenAI API. I developed the front end and Node proxy for token-by-token streaming, with the first token appearing in about 600 ms and support for 30k chats a month.

If you’d like, I can help you define the site structure, build the pages, and make sure everything is ready for launch.
